anya: Heads-up — ran into a weird case where a scope merge during a flag rollout caused tenant B to pick up tenant A's quota override. Not producing outage but metric spikes. :grimacing:
kevin: ugh. repro steps?
anya: quick summary — we merged scope 'team-a:beta' into 'org-123:all' (dry run on console). the merge produced a combined scope key that our runtime uses for precedence. runtime evaluated quota=100 for org-123 even though team-a was supposed to be limited.
michael: do we have a minimal config snippet?
anya: pasted below:
```yaml
flags:
  - name: new-routing-experiment
    scopes:
      - id: team-a:beta
        quota: 10
      - id: org-123:all
        quota: 100
    merged: true  # merge happened via console action
```
sara: Hmm, so console merge set merged=true and we didn't re-evaluate precedence. runtime just picked the highest quota?
kevin: runtime precedence rules are: explicit scope > org scope > default, but when scopes get coalesced we lost explicit markers. Bug.
olivia: is this specific to quota, or other attrs (ttl, model override) as well?
anya: saw quota and ttl differences; model override looked ok.
michael: can we add a quick guard: if merged scopes have conflicting numeric controls (quota, burst), require manual reconcile or create an escalation alert?
kevin: yes — propose short-term: block console merge if numeric keys differ. Long-term: add deterministic merge resolution w/ audit trail.
sara: telemetry note: we need an event flag.merge_attempt and flag.merge_conflict with payload {scope_ids, diffs, user}. sample rate 100% for now.
olivia: agree, need audit trail in console UI listing diffs before commit. UX should show inline diff for numeric fields with recommended resolution (min/max/choose).
anya: deploy-bot: can we add a dry-run action that simulates runtime precedence and shows final effective config?
deploy-bot: :robot_face: scheduled job created: flag-merge-dryrun-sim for org-123 queued, runs in ~5m.
michael: ops playbook idea: for now, when merge is blocked, create a 'reconcile ticket' prefilled with scopes/diffs and assign to flag owner. Also attach telemetry logs.
kevin: implementation notes: two parts — console (prevent/preview) + runtime (reject ambiguous merged config or mark merged config with per-field provenance). we should add a provenance map: field -> origin_scope_id.
sara: provenance map sounds good. telemetry events should include provenance so we can trace back unexpected effective values.
anya: API debate: do we return 409 on POST /flags/merge if conflict, or return 200 with a 'conflicts' array? Current console flow expects errors.
michael: prefer 409 for automation safety. console can interpret 409 and surface a modal with diffs. API clients get deterministic failure on ambiguous ops.
olivia: but that breaks existing clients doing blind merges. We should version the merge endpoint: /flags/merge?strict=true default on v2. Backcompat on v1 with warning in header.
kevin: agreed. v2 strict mode returns 409 + conflicts; also returns a dry_run_id to preview resolution.
sara: ops monitoring: create grafana panel for merge_conflict_count and merge_dryrun_latency. add an alert if conflict_count > 5/hour for an org.
anya: rollout plan: 1) console UI diff modal + block when numeric mismatch, behind feature flag; 2) API v2 strict mode + 409 responses; 3) runtime add per-field provenance and reject ambiguous merged payloads; 4) telemetry events + dashboard; 5) run a week of dry-run for top 10 orgs before enforced rollout.
michael: timeline?
anya: propose PRs this week for telemetry + API spec. console changes next sprint. runtime work needs more design — can we add a temporary server-side validation in the config service to fail merges early?
kevin: yes we can gate in config service in front of runtime, low-friction.
olivia: I can own console UX. sara will own telemetry and dashboard. Kevin + Michael handle API/runtime validation. Anya will coordinate dry-run & tickets.
sara: will add alert runbook: how to revert, emphasize 'do not merge' quick rollback for org-level mergers.
michael: quick checklist for PRs: add event schema, add conflicts field in API error, update OpenAPI spec, return dry_run_id.
anya: ok assigning: @olivia UX, @sara telemetry, @kevin runtime validation + provenance spec, @michael API + openapi updates. I'll schedule a sync tomorrow 10am PT.
kevin: thanks. i'll write up a short RFC and post it to #eng-platform-rfc. :thumbsup:
olivia: will mock modal and push screenshots to the thread. :eyes:
anya: thanks all — feel better having a concrete playbook. will follow up with PR links and dry-run results.
